description:
[read-only] Scheduled posts waiting for (or given) a human sign-off, oldest slot first. Page with limit/cursor; filter with slotBefore/slotAfter (ISO), postStatus, status and window. Held/missed exclude cancelled/deleted posts unless includeGone=true. total counts matching reviews per status across all pages. `canApprove` tells whether THIS connection may approve each one.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/reviews.)

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

includeGone.description: Include cancelled/deleted posts in held/missed results (including status=all). Defaults to false.

postStatus.description: Exact underlying post status, e.g. review_held or missed_review. Rows without a post do not match.

slotAfter.description: Only slots strictly after this ISO timestamp (timezone required). Undated reviews excluded.

slotBefore.description: Only slots strictly before this ISO timestamp (timezone required). Undated reviews excluded.

name: list_reviews
title: List scheduled-post reviews
